profile.headline: Strategic Data Engineer | AWS/Databricks Expert (PySpark/Scala) | MBA in Innovation | Cricket Coach & Player/Sports Management
profile.summary:
I am a Strategic Data Engineering Leader and entrepreneurial executive who drives business growth by bridging advanced cloud technology with executive strategy. With over a decade of progressive IT experience, I specialize in transforming complex data infrastructure into clear, measurable actionable insights and scalable solutions.

I am a proven expert in AWS (S3, Lambda, CloudWatch) and Databricks (PySpark, Scala), known for designing and optimizing highly performant, high-velocity data pipelines that consistently reduce time-to-insight and improve operational efficiency. My technical foundation is robust, with experience extending to Python, Java, SQL, Hadoop, and Bash, coupled with prior expertise in IT security and compliance (Symantec, QRADAR, Forescout).

My unique background includes significant senior-level management, where I successfully co-founded and scaled a competitive sports franchise. This experience involved leading complex global operations and logistical planning for a 40+ person contingent, ensuring 100% operational readiness and strict financial/regulatory compliance. I am adept at strategic marketing (#spsmmarketing) and driving visibility, having secured corporate sponsorships and grown fan engagement.

My expertise is underpinned by an MBA in Entrepreneurship & Innovation Management and a B.S. in Computer Engineering (Drexel University), providing the necessary framework to link deep technical solutions directly to business strategy, risk mitigation, and executive decision-making. I am committed to leveraging emerging technologies to drive transformation and solve high-stakes business challenges.

positions.title: Media and Marketing
positions.description:
• Strategic Growth & Planning: Developed and executed full-funnel, multi-channel marketing strategies (SEO, Content, SMM, Paid Media) that consistently achieved core business objectives and revenue growth targets.
• Data-Driven Decision Making: Expertly analyzed complex marketing data (ROI, CPA, LTV, engagement metrics) from platforms like Google Analytics and CRM to drive actionable insights and optimize spend efficiency.
• MarTech & Automation Proficiency: Deep expertise in leveraging Marketing Automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo) for advanced lead nurturing, segmentation, and personalized customer journeys.
• Brand & Product Positioning: Defined and articulated compelling value propositions and differentiated brand positioning through rigorous market research and consumer insight analysis.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Led successful Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies, collaborating closely with Sales and Product teams to ensure cohesive messaging and maximized market penetration.
• Content & Digital Expertise: Directed high-value content strategies and optimization efforts, significantly improving organic visibility and establishing the brand as a thought leader in the industry.
• Budget & ROI Management: Accountable for million-dollar (or similar scale) marketing budgets, consistently delivering a strong Return on Investment (ROI) by rigorous performance tracking and reallocation.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Team Management · Building Trust · Analytical Skills · Strategy · Project Plans · Microsoft 365 · Project Management · Client Communication · Strategic Content Development · Creative Problem Solving

positions.title: Engineer II
positions.description:
Data Engineering & Platform Optimization:
• Cloud Data Pipeline & Architecture: Led the design and development of scalable, high-availability data solutions utilizing AWS core services (S3, CloudWatch, Lambda) to support and maintain mission-critical data pipelines.
• Big Data Processing & Time-to-Insight: Integrated Databricks into existing workflows, leveraging PySpark and Scala for the execution of ad hoc notebooks and production cluster jobs, resulting in a significant enhancement of big data processing capabilities.
• Operational Efficiency & Monitoring: Engineered and implemented a highly efficient job monitoring solution, effectively streamlining the tracking of ingress and egress data jobs to ensure seamless data processing and a reduction in manual interventions.
• Codebase Development & Scalability: Developed and optimized scalable, maintainable codebases in Python, Scala, and PySpark, driving the efficiency and velocity of data pipelines across high-volume operational systems.
• Deployment Automation: Established automated frameworks and scripts for DDL updates and database integration with Windows authentication, improving deployment speed, consistency, and reducing manual errors in database change management.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement:
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partnered with various cross-functional teams (e.g., Employee and Equipment groups) to identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, directly improving workflow efficiency and reducing process delays.
• Quality Assurance & UAT: Actively participated in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new development and decommissioning projects, ensuring all technical solutions met performance and user standards for smooth, low-impact transitions.
• Knowledge Transfer & Mentorship: Led technical onboarding and training for new hires, and contributed to comprehensive documentation of internal frameworks, ensuring smooth knowledge transfer and team continuity.

positions.title: Engineer 1
positions.description:
Core Engineering & Automation:
• Operational Efficiency Tooling: Developed and deployed a custom job monitoring tool to efficiently track and manage ingress and egress data jobs, ensuring highly streamlined data workflows and reducing manual checks.
• Codebase Development & Support: Built and maintained a robust, production-grade codebase utilizing Python and Bash scripting, directly supporting the functionality of the monitoring tool and enhancing overall operational stability and efficiency.
• Database Automation: Designed and implemented frameworks and scripts to fully automate DDL updates, significantly simplifying database management processes and improving change consistency.
• System Integration & Scalability: Established a scalable framework for SQL source integration utilizing Windows authentication, successfully improving system compatibility and deployment security across the environment.
• Tool Functionality Enhancement: Optimized monitoring and management tool functionality through advanced application of SQL Developer expertise and Job Control Management (JCM) practices.

Documentation & Team Enablement:
• Knowledge Transfer & Mentorship: Acted as a key internal resource, mentoring teammates on complex existing systems and processes to ensure high proficiency and operational redundancy.
• Technical Documentation: Authored detailed, comprehensive documentation for all new frameworks and tools, facilitating seamless knowledge transfer and ensuring long-term maintainability and scalability.

positions.title: Senior Team Manager
positions.description:
• Global Operations Leadership: Directed all complex logistical planning for domestic and international tours, overseeing scheduling, accommodation, and secure ground transport for a 40+ person contingent across multiple continents, consistently ensuring 100% operational readiness for all high-stakes events.
• Strategic Financial Management: Managed and reconciled a multi-thousand dollar annual operational budget (specify currency if appropriate), significantly optimizing spending across travel, equipment, and support services while maintaining strict adherence to corporate and franchise financial protocols.
• Executive & Stakeholder Liaison: Served as the primary communication nexus between the Head Coach/Captain, Franchise CEO/Owners, and the league (T10 Sports), streamlining critical information flow and driving centralized operational decision-making.
• Compliance & Risk Mitigation: Ensured strict regulatory compliance across all team personnel and staff with league rules and integrity requirements (e.g., anti-doping/anti-corruption), successfully mitigating the risk of penalties, sanctions, or major operational disruption.
• Personnel & Administrative Oversight: Managed all complex player administrative requirements, including global visa processing, contract onboarding, player transfers, and injury reporting documentation, guaranteeing timely and compliant player participation.
• Team Welfare & Environment: Cultivated and maintained a high-trust professional environment by managing daily non-sporting affairs, handling sensitive player welfare issues with discretion, and expertly coordinating the activities of all support staff (medical, analyst, media).

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Startup & Franchise Establishment: Co-founded and successfully established a competitive cricket franchise, driving its launch from concept to fully operational status while focusing on community engagement and regional brand promotion.
• Integrated Marketing & Visibility: Developed and executed comprehensive marketing initiatives (leveraging digital and local channels) to dramatically enhance franchise visibility, successfully attracting 20 players, growing the fan base by 10%, and securing key sponsors.
• Sponsorship Acquisition: Led the business development and acquisition process, securing 3 corporate sponsorships through compelling pitch development and relationship management.
• Strategic Operations Management: Strategized and managed all core organizational operations, including team recruitment, complex event logistics, and contractual negotiations, managing an operational budget in the hundreds of thousands of dollars.
• Community & Stakeholder Relations: Coordinated closely with local organizations and league officials to promote cricket, strengthening community ties and increasing the sport's regional footprint.
• Team & Culture Development: Championed a high-performance team culture and development program, which directly contributed to competitive on-field performance and high player retention.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Culture · Observation · Project Team Management · Building Trust · Analytical Skills · Time Management · Project Plans · Innovation Management · Microsoft 365 · Communication · Leadership

positions.title: Information Technology Security Analyst
positions.locationName: Wilmington, DE and Philadelphia, PA · On-site
positions.description:
• Threat Detection & Analysis: Actively monitored and analyzed real-time network activity utilizing Symantec tools, playing a key role in early detection and flagging of suspicious activities across critical servers and systems.
• Network Access Control (NAC): Revised and managed security policies on Forescout CounterAct to detect, control, and remediate unauthorized (rogue) devices, significantly strengthening network perimeter security.
• Access Management & Compliance: Conducted identity certifications via the RSA application to ensure secure and compliant user access management across the organization.
• Security Process Optimization: Maintained detailed records of high-volume helpdesk tickets, facilitating efficient resolution of IT security issues and contributing data for process improvement.
• Advanced Monitoring & Rules Implementation: Collaborated with QRADAR to implement complex rules and policies focused on detecting and monitoring sophisticated threats, including bot devices and unusual network behaviors.
• Risk Reporting & Auditing: Contributed to the generation and compilation of detailed incident reports using tools from Digital Defense Incorporated, enhancing overall threat detection and analysis capabilities.
• Policy Compliance: Assisted in maintaining, reviewing, and auditing security policies and controls to ensure strict adherence to organizational standards and compliance protocols, successfully minimizing system vulnerabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Observation · Pivot Tables · Technical Documentation · Microsoft 365 · Communication

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Custom Solution Development: Led the design, development, and implementation of custom software solutions specifically engineered to streamline core business processes and enhance operational efficiency within the healthcare sector.
• Code Quality & Technology: Wrote clean, scalable, and efficient production code using Java, C#, and Python, ensuring strict adherence to coding best practices and corporate standards.
• Debugging & Optimization: Executed comprehensive debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of software applications to ensure smooth system performance and rapid resolution of technical issues.
• Quality Assurance & Reliability: Conducted rigorous software testing, including unit and integration testing, guaranteeing the reliability and functionality of applications prior to deployment.
• Integration & Interoperability: Assisted with the technical integration of third-party APIs and services into internal applications, successfully expanding system functionality and improving data interoperability.
• Agile Collaboration: Participated actively in regular code reviews and engineering team discussions, contributing feedback to continuously improve overall codebase quality and development processes.
• Technical Support & Training: Provided hands-on technical support and training to staff on new software tools, ensuring smooth adoption and maximized usage across various departments.
• System Documentation: Maintained and updated comprehensive software documentation, ensuring that all code changes, system updates, and technical specifications were accurately recorded for knowledge transfer and future scalability.

positions.title: Global Information Technology and Security Analyst
positions.description:
• Global Threat Monitoring: Oversaw and actively monitored global network activities, leveraging Symantec tools for real-time monitoring and threat detection across the international enterprise environment.
• International Network Access Control (NAC): Revised and optimized security policies on Forescout CounterAct, enabling the efficient identification and risk management of unauthorized (rogue) devices across international networks.
• Global Access Management: Conducted identity certifications using the RSA application, responsible for managing secure access controls and maintaining user permissions across a global user base.
• Secure File Transfer & Compliance: Administered secure file transfers and access management utilizing the Accellion SFT application, ensuring strict compliance with global security and data transfer standards.
• Enterprise Threat Mitigation: Collaborated with QRADAR to establish and implement global security rules and policies, enhancing enterprise-wide bot device detection and threat mitigation strategies.
• Global Auditing & Risk: Played a key role in global security audits and vulnerability assessments, ensuring all processes and systems maintained alignment with international security frameworks and compliance regulations.
• Incident Analysis & Reporting: Coordinated the monitoring and analysis of helpdesk tickets to identify recurring global security trends and compiled incident reports using Digital Defense Incorporated tools for comprehensive cross-regional threat analysis.
• Protocol & Knowledge Transfer: Developed and maintained documentation for global security protocols, policies, and best practices, ensuring consistency and compliance across all operating regions.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Worked closely with regional and global teams to actively promote awareness of current security risks, ensuring strong alignment with overarching organizational security objectives.

projects.title: ENTD (Encrypted Network Traffic Detection)
projects.description:
ENTD, Encrypted Network Traffic Detector, is a Python 3 program for analyzing packet captures (pcaps) and distinguishing between benign and malicious traffic in the packet via port 443 (SSL/TLS).

Currently the features that are supported are as follows:

Reading Packet Capture and Extracting the Server Hello Information
Able to distinguish between Malicious and Benign Traffic
Usage
You can use the program in Python 3 with

./main.py -f "path/to/packet/capture/file.pcap"
Example
./main.py -f "Sample PCAPs/malicious_packet.pcap"
Requirements
Python 3.6.1 or newer
dpkt via pip install dpkt
mlxtend via pip install mlxtend
scikit-learn via pip install scikit-learn
mysqlclient via pip install mysqlclient
Issues
Currently the SVM shows a hyperplane due to the ciphersuites. Need more data to fill our feature space.
Currently builds the SVM model every run through.
There is a bug in dpkt with reading packets. Therefore, I have hand constructed the JSON features from the malicious packet we have.
